title: Wildfire
summary: WILDFIRE, noun [wild and fire.] 1. A composition of inflammable materials. Brimstone, pitch, wildfire burn easily, and are hard to quench. 2. A disease of sheep, attended with inflammation of the skin

inlines.v: WILDFIRE, noun [wild and fire.] 1. A composition of inflammable materials. Brimstone, pitch, wildfire burn easily, and are hard to quench. 2. A disease of sheep, attended with inflammation of the skin; a kind of erysipelas.
